formal_proof: Let R0 be the basic reproduction number (the expected number of secondary cases). If a fraction 'p' of the population is immune (blocking the viral entry mechanism), the effective reproduction number Re = R0 * (1 - p). The epidemic declines when Re < 1, which algebraically resolves to p > 1 - 1/R0.
context_description: This is the mathematical proof of herd immunity. By blocking the virus from entering enough cells (either via vaccines or prior infection), the chain of transmission is physically severed.
